recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-37707 unless a future work group decision changes the general CanonicalResource publisher pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-37707 asked to correct ObservationDefinition.publisher from Reference(Practitioner | PractitionerRole | Organization) to string so ObservationDefinition would be consistent with the CanonicalResource publisher interface.
initial_application: The combined branch had no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-37707. Historical commit aa77541a50f28454a204f1a501b9b867c6b750e6, titled '#38797 and #37707', changed ObservationDefinition.publisher from Reference with Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and Organization target profiles to string.
additional_context: FHIR-37707 was decided opportunistically because the FHIR-38797 Jira comment says the two issues describe the same error in two definitional resources, and both were applied by the same source commit. Zulip discussion in the IG creation stream narrowed the ObservationDefinition problem to the publisher datatype. OO minutes on 2022-10-04 marked FHIR-37707 Will Fix, and 2022-12-02 OO Catalog minutes record FHIR-37707 with FHIR-38797 as applied/DONE. Later FHIR-38161 cleanup added other canonical elements without reverting ObservationDefinition.publisher.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source change is needed: the active authoritative source already satisfies the requested datatype correction.

related_jiras.note: SpecimenDefinition had the same publisher datatype error and was fixed in the same historical source commit.
Later canonical-resource cleanup added other canonical elements to ObservationDefinition and SpecimenDefinition without changing publisher back from string.
